How Much Is a Pint in Toronto? Beer Prices (2026)

In Toronto, a pint usually costs $9.50 to $12 CAD before tax and tip in 2026. Happy hour knocks a few dollars off, and a few places still pour under $8. Here's what we found across 38 bars.

By the ontap team · 26 October 2026

Toronto beer prices at a glance

PriceSource
Typical pint, Torontoabout $11.50 CADCities Insider, Jun 2026
Typical pint in a major Canadian cityabout $10 CADinsauga, Jul 2026
Middle of the menus we checked, per 20 oz (568 ml)$10.13 CADontap, Oct 2026 (half paid $9.45–$12)
Typical happy-hour pint (usually 16 oz)about $6.50 CADontap, Oct 2026

Like elsewhere in Canada, menu prices exclude 13% HST and the tip, so budget about a third more than the menu says.

Tips for a cheaper night in Toronto

  • Student-area pubs around U of T and the Annex keep prices lower than King West or the Entertainment District.
  • Ontario beers (Steam Whistle, Amsterdam, Mill Street, Great Lakes) are usually the cheapest taps.
  • Check the size: 20 oz pints are common in Toronto pubs and are better value than they look next to 16 oz.

How we got these numbers

In October 2026 we collected 65 Toronto beer prices from 38 bars and recent guides, recorded size, source and date for each, and counted happy hour separately.

FAQ

How much is a pint in Toronto?

Usually $9.50–$12 CAD before tax and tip in 2026; about $10 for a 20 oz in the middle of the menus we checked.

What's the cheapest beer in Toronto?

We found a $3.95 house pilsner at Tondou Ramen and $6 select beers at Sneaky Dee's; see the table above.

Is tax included in Toronto bar prices?

Usually not. Add 13% HST plus a 15–20% tip.
